June 19 1923

INSPECTION Daily Report

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence

Sir,

The Korean National Convention which has been in session in Frenchtown for several months completed its work a few days ago. Many subjects are reported to have been discussed at the Convention, including proposals for the re-organization of the Korean Provisional Government. These discussions revealed considerable differences of opinion among the delegates who are divided into three parties. The strongest party, which has Communist sympathies and is well supplied with funds, demanded that the independence movement should be remodeled in accordance with their views. The second strongest party advocate the shaping of the independence movement on democratic lines, while the third and weakest party consisting of the Old Provisional Government consider that they should be allowed to retain power, but should be strengthened with financial support from the other parties. Han Hyung Kuen(韓亨權), who was sent to Moscow by the Korean Provisional Government, to get financial support about three years ago and received about $200,000 from the Soviet Government partly for the Communist propaganda and partly for the Korean revolutionary work, is the leader of the strongest party. Kim Hai(尹海), who acted as representative of Korea in Paris during the Peace Conference and Wong Sz Heon(元世勳), a Korean Communist leader in Siberia, are his chief lieutenants. The middle party is led by Ahn Chong Ho(安昌浩), Ex-Minister of Labour in the Korean Provisional Government, who has a large following

阁下：

在法租界已召开数月的朝鲜国民大会于数日前结束工作。据报，大会上讨论了许多议题，包括改组朝鲜临时政府的提案。这些讨论显示代表们之间存在显著的意见分歧，他们分为三个派系。实力最强、具有共产主义倾向且资金充裕的派系要求按照其观点改造独立运动。实力居中的派系主张以民主路线塑造独立运动，而实力最弱、由原临时政府成员组成的第三派系则认为应允许其保留权力，但需得到其他派系的财政支持。韩亨权（Han Hyung Kuen）是实力最强派系的领袖，他约三年前受朝鲜临时政府派遣前往莫斯科寻求财政支持，并从苏维埃政府获得约20万美元，部分用于共产主义宣传，部分用于朝鲜革命工作。他的主要副手包括金海（Kim Hai，音译），此人曾在和平会议期间担任朝鲜驻巴黎代表；以及元世勳（Wong Sz Heon），此人是西伯利亚地区的朝鲜共产党领导人。中间派系由安昌浩（Ahn Chong Ho）领导，他是朝鲜临时政府前劳工部长，拥有大量追随者

(金東三), a big leader of Koreans in North Chientao,
Manchuria. The leaders of the third party are Song Jung Do
(宋貞道), ex-Minister of Communications in the Korean
Provisional Government, Cho Sang Sub(趙尚燮), a member
of the Korean Senate, and Li Eyu Pil(李裕弼), ex-Vice
Minister of Finance in the Korean Provisional Government.
Taking advantage of the absence of the other two parties at
one sitting of the Convention the strongest party passed a
resolution in favour of the re-organization of the
Provisional Government and its policy. This displeased
the other two parties whose delegates withdrew from the
Convention. The expenses of the Convention and the delegates
were paid by the strongest party which, however, withdrew
all financial help after the crisis described. Han Hyung
Kuon(韓亨權) appeared to be the man who controlled the
purse. The Convention has left the local Korean community
torn asunder with dissension, and it is not improbable
that this feature of the matter will cause trouble in
the future. It is also reported that the strongest party
has already organized a new Korean Government, but no
official announcement has yet been made on this subject.

在朝鲜北部，李鐸（Li Taik），前满洲军事委员会委员长，以及金东三（Kim Dong San），满洲间岛北部朝鲜人的重要领袖。第三派系的领导人是宋贞道（Song Jung Do），朝鲜临时政府前交通总长；赵尚燮（Cho Sang Sub），朝鲜参议院议员；以及李裕弼（Li Eyu Pil），朝鲜临时政府前财政部次长。利用另外两个派系缺席某次会议的机会，实力最强的派系通过了一项赞成改组临时政府及其政策的决议。此举令另外两个派系不满，其代表退出了大会。大会及代表的费用由实力最强的派系支付，但在上述危机发生后，该派系撤回了所有财政援助。韩亨权（Han Hyung Kuon，原文拼写有误，应为韩亨权）似乎是掌控资金的人。此次大会使当地朝鲜社群因内讧而分裂，这一事态未来很可能引发麻烦。另有报告称，实力最强的派系已组建一个新的朝鲜政府，但对此尚未发布正式公告。
